name: Gusuku Sites and Related Properties of the Kingdom of Ryukyu
description: Scattered across Okinawa Prefecture in southern Japan, these nine sites include the hilltop stone ramparts of Ryukyu's castles, the royal Tamaudun mausoleum, a royal garden and sacred groves where an ancient island faith is still practised. Built between the 12th and 17th centuries, they reflect a kingdom that traded widely and blended Japanese and Chinese influences into its own distinct culture.
